FRE_ROOM_SCAN.Subtitle: BLD_FRE_ROOM_SCAN_SUB
FRE_ROOM_SCAN.Description_Text:
Advanced integrated freighter equipment. Upon use, this <TECHNOLOGY>planetary scanner<> probes all celestial bodies in the local solar system. This module is placed as an <STELLAR>entire room<> and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

Scanned moons and planets are <STELLAR>Discovered<>, and sensors collect high-level data such as weather conditions and prominent resources.

FRE_ROOM_SHOP.Subtitle: BLD_FRE_ROOM_SUB
FRE_ROOM_SHOP.Description_Text:
Integrated freighter equipment providing instant local access to the <TECHNOLOGY>galactic trade market<> for resources and commodities.

This module is placed as an <STELLAR>entire room<> and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

FRE_ROOM_TELEPO.Description_Text:
Vital integrated freighter equipment. This <TECHNOLOGY>personal teleport device<> allows the user to move quickly between their freighter, planetary bases, as well as any Space Station Terminuses connected to their network. User is urged to verify network integrity before inserting any matter they cannot afford to become separated from.

This module is placed as an <STELLAR>entire room<> and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

FRE_ROOM_DRESS.Subtitle: BLD_FRE_ROOM_DRESS_SUB
FRE_ROOM_DRESS.Description_Text:
Integrated freighter equipment allowing the user to <TECHNOLOGY>adjust their personal appearance<> settings. This module is placed as an <STELLAR>entire room<> and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

The module applies advanced holographic techniques to recalibrate the light around the user, allowing them to adopt whatever appearance they desire. Visual data must be properly formatted before use.

BASE_FLAG.Name: UI_BASE_ANYWHERE_NAME
BASE_FLAG.Subtitle: UI_BASE_ANYWHERE_SUB
BASE_FLAG.Description_Text:
Portable land registration service.

When placed, contacts Universal Cartographic Archive to establish ownership of land. Successful registration allows the construction of base modules across any site of the user's choosing.

BUILDLANDINGPAD.Name: BLD_LANDINGPAD_NAME
BUILDLANDINGPAD.Subtitle: BLD_LANDINGPAD_SUBTITLE
BUILDLANDINGPAD.Description_Text: A stable, reinforced landing pad for starships.

BUILDTERMINAL.Name: BLD_TRADETERMINAL_NAME
BUILDTERMINAL.Subtitle: BLD_TRADETERMINAL_SUBTITLE
BUILDTERMINAL.Description_Text: A trading terminal that provides instant local access to the market for resources and commodities.

HEALTHSTATION.Name: BLD_HEALTHSTATION_NAME
HEALTHSTATION.Subtitle: BLD_HEALTHSTATION_SUBTITLE
HEALTHSTATION.Description_Text: A wall mounted module that can be used to recharge health.

SHIELDSTATION.Name: BLD_HAZSTATION_NAME
SHIELDSTATION.Subtitle: BLD_HAZSTATION_SUBTITLE
SHIELDSTATION.Description_Text:
A wall mounted module that can be used to recharge the user's <COMMODITY>Hazard Protection<> systems.

The Hazard Protection Unit must be kept charged with a source of <FUEL>fuel<>.

BUILDSAVE.Name: BLD_SAVEPOINT_NAME
BUILDSAVE.Subtitle: BLD_SAVEPOINT_SUBTITLE
BUILDSAVE.Description_Text: A buildable save point for managing your progress.

BUILDBEACON.Name: BLD_BEACON_NAME
BUILDBEACON.Subtitle: BLD_BEACON_SUBTITLE
BUILDBEACON.Description_Text:
Once activated, beacons provide a permanent navigational waypoint, facilitating repeat visits to specific locations.

Allows user to record their progress at any time.

BUILDSIGNAL.Name: BLD_SIGNAL_NAME
BUILDSIGNAL.Subtitle: BLD_SIGNAL_SUBTITLE
BUILDSIGNAL.Description_Text:
A versatile scanner that <TECHNOLOLY>detects nearby buildings<>. Can decrypt <COMMODITY>Navigation Data<> to pinpoint specific locations.

The Signal Booster can be <VAL_ON>dismantled and redeployed<> for easy transportation.

BUILDANTIMATTER.Name: BLD_ANTIMATTER_NAME
BUILDANTIMATTER.Subtitle: BLD_ANTIMATTER_SUB
BUILDANTIMATTER.Description_Text:
An <TECHNOLOGY>autonomous baryogenesis reactor<>, this device can be left to harvest reality paradoxes and convert them into usable <FUEL>antimatter<>. User must monitor fuel levels to ensure continued operation.

The resulting antimatter is safely contained, ready for use in all standard <FUEL>hyperspace power units<>.

TELEPORTER.Name: UI_BASE_TELEPORT_NAME
TELEPORTER.Subtitle: UI_BASE_TELEPORT_SUB
TELEPORTER.Description_Text:
A <TECHNOLOGY>personal teleport device<>, allowing the user to move quickly between their constructed bases, as well as any Space Station Terminuses connected to their network.

User is urged to verify network integrity before inserting any matter they cannot afford to become separated from.

A <TECHNOLOGY>personal teleport device<>, allowing the user to move quickly between their constructed bases, as well as any Space Station Terminuses connected to their network.

User is urged to verify network integrity before inserting any matter they cannot afford to become separated from.

BASECAPSULE.Name: UI_BASE_CAPSULE_NAME
BASECAPSULE.Subtitle: UI_BASE_CAPSULE_SUB
BASECAPSULE.Description_Text:
A <COMMODITY>construction recovery device<>.

This optional piece of base technology stores and preserves matter left over after the destruction of a previous base.

BP_ANALYSER.Name: UI_BP_ANALYSER_NAME
BP_ANALYSER.Subtitle: UI_BP_ANALYSER_SUB
BP_ANALYSER.Description_Text:
Portable <TECHNOLOGY>blueprint research device<>.

This field-deployable research module allows the user to convert old or damaged technology modules into advanced construction blueprints.

BUILD_REFINER1.Name: REFINER1_NAME
BUILD_REFINER1.Subtitle: REFINER_SUB
BUILD_REFINER1.Description_Text:
A vital piece of planetary equipment. The <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> allows gathered substances to be processed into more powerful and more advanced materials.

The Portable Refiner can be <VAL_ON>dismantled and redeployed<> for easy transportation. Note: the Portable Refiner requires <FUEL>fuel<> to operate.

BUILD_REFINER2.Name: REFINER2_NAME
BUILD_REFINER2.Subtitle: REFINER_SUB
BUILD_REFINER2.Description_Text:
A vital piece of planetary equipment. The <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> allows gathered substances to be processed into more powerful and more advanced materials.

The Medium Refiner allows <COMMODITY>two<> different substances to be combined into one new material, or materials to be processed at better ratios. 

The Medium Refiner must be installed in a <VAL_ON>Habitable Base<>, but does not require additional power sources.

BUILD_REFINER3.Name: REFINER3_NAME
BUILD_REFINER3.Subtitle: REFINER_SUB
BUILD_REFINER3.Description_Text:
A vital piece of planetary equipment. The <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> allows gathered substances to be processed into more powerful and more advanced materials.

The Large Refiner allows <COMMODITY>three<> different substances to be combined into one new material, or materials to be processed at better ratios. 

The Large Refiner must be installed in a <VAL_ON>Habitable Base<>, but does not require additional power sources.

DRESSING_TABLE.Name: DRESSING_TABLE_NAME
DRESSING_TABLE.Subtitle: DRESSING_TABLE_SUB
DRESSING_TABLE.Description_Text:
A buildable module that allows the users to <TECHNOLOGY>adjust their personal appearance<> settings.

The module applies advanced holographic techniques to recalibrate the light around the user, allowing them to adopt whatever appearance they desire. Visual data must be properly formated before use.

COOKER.Name: UI_OVEN_NAME
COOKER.Subtitle: UI_OVEN_SUB
COOKER.Description_Text:
A portable <TECHNOLOGY>nutrient extractor<>, able to process and refine gathered ingredients into edible food products.

User is advised that consumption of generated products is entirely at their own risk.

CREATURE_FEED.Name: UI_CREATURE_FEED_NAME
CREATURE_FEED.Subtitle: UI_CREATURE_FEED_SUB
CREATURE_FEED.Description_Text:
A robotic farming unit, designed to <STELLAR>automatically supply nearby creatures with food<>.

When powered, will attract nearby animal life. Keep bait tanks full in order to supply lifeforms with desired food.

CREATURE_FARM.Name: UI_CREATURE_FARM_NAME
CREATURE_FARM.Subtitle: UI_CREATURE_FARM_SUB
CREATURE_FARM.Description_Text:
A robotic farming unit, designed to <STELLAR>automatically harvest<> substances from creatures. Requires <STELLAR>power<>.

Creatures that are ready to be harvested for milk, eggs or other specialist produce will approach the Livestock Unit and deposit their yields. The creatures are unharmed by the process.

Will harvest produce from creatures fed by hand or via an <TECHNOLOGY>Automated Feeder<>.

SHIPSUMMON.Name: BLD_SHIPSUMMON_NAME
SHIPSUMMON.Subtitle: BLD_SHIPSUMMON_SUBTITLE
SHIPSUMMON.Description_Text: A buildable device that can summon your starship to it from any location.

MESSAGEMODULE.Name: BLD_MESSAGEMODULE_NAME
MESSAGEMODULE.Subtitle: BLD_MESSAGEMODULE_SUBTITLE
MESSAGEMODULE.Description_Text: A small and accessible information container for leaving messages or viewing left messages and short strings of information.

MESSAGE.Name: BLD_MESSAGE_NAME
MESSAGE.Subtitle: BLD_MESSAGE_SUBTITLE
MESSAGE.Description_Text: A terminal for the composition and transmission of messages to other travellers.

GARAGE_S.Name: BLD_GARAGE_S_NAME
GARAGE_S.Subtitle: BLD_GARAGE_S_SUBTITLE
GARAGE_S.Description_Text: An underground secure parking facility for the Nomad light Exocraft.

GARAGE_M.Name: BLD_GARAGE_M_NAME
GARAGE_M.Subtitle: BLD_GARAGE_M_SUBTITLE
GARAGE_M.Description_Text: An underground secure parking facility for the Roamer medium Exocraft.

GARAGE_L.Name: BLD_GARAGE_L_NAME
GARAGE_L.Subtitle: BLD_GARAGE_L_SUBTITLE

GARAGE_B.Name: BLD_GARAGE_B_NAME
GARAGE_B.Subtitle: BLD_GARAGE_B_SUBTITLE
GARAGE_B.Description_Text: An underground secure parking facility for the Pilgrim light Exocraft.

GARAGE_SUB.Name: BLD_GARAGE_SUB_NAME
GARAGE_SUB.Subtitle: BLD_GARAGE_SUB_SUBTITLE
GARAGE_SUB.Description_Text: An advanced, fully-airlocked docking station for the Nautilon submarine.

GARAGE_FLOAT.Name: BLD_GARAGE_FLOAT_NAME
GARAGE_FLOAT.Subtitle: BLD_GARAGE_FLOAT_SUBTITLE
GARAGE_FLOAT.Description_Text:
An advanced, fully-watertight docking station for the <TECHNOLOGY>Nautilon submarine<>.

This specially adapted platform is designed to be <STELLAR>deployed on the surface of the water<>.

SUMMON_GARAGE.Name: EXO_SUMMON_POD_NAME
SUMMON_GARAGE.Subtitle: EXO_SUMMON_POD_SUB
SUMMON_GARAGE.Description_Text: Construction allows the user to summon any owned Exocraft from anywhere<> else in that system. Interfaces with the Exosuit Quick Command Menu<> for ease of use. Can be compressed and carried within the Exosuit with DECONSTRUCT<> for later redeployment.

GARAGE_MECH.Name: BLD_GARAGE_MECH_NAME
GARAGE_MECH.Subtitle: BLD_GARAGE_MECH_SUB
GARAGE_MECH.Description_Text:
A secure parking, summoning and customisation facility for the <STELLAR>Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid<>.

The Minotaur Geobay can be constructed anywhere on a planet's surface.

Deploy the Minotaur from the Quick Menu. With the aid of an <TECHNOLOGY>Orbital Exocraft Materialiser<> mounted inside a freighter, the Minotaur can be instantly deployed to any location within the same system as the mothership.

NPCSCIENCETERM.Name: BLD_NPCSCIENCE_NAME
NPCSCIENCETERM.Subtitle: BLD_NPCSCIENCE_SUBTITLE
NPCSCIENCETERM.Description_Text: A research station tailored to the needs of Scientists, and equipped for research and development of scientific blueprints.

NPCWEAPONTERM.Name: BLD_NPCWEAPON_NAME
NPCWEAPONTERM.Subtitle: BLD_NPCWEAPON_SUBTITLE
NPCWEAPONTERM.Description_Text: A research station tailored to the needs of Armourers, and equipped for the development of munitions and explosives as well as selected civilian tech.

NPCFARMTERM.Name: BLD_NPCFARM_NAME
NPCFARMTERM.Subtitle: BLD_NPCFARM_SUBTITLE
NPCFARMTERM.Description_Text: A research station tailored to the needs of Farmers, and equipped for the analysis and cultivation of farmable crops.

NPCVEHICLETERM.Name: BLD_NPCVEHICLE_NAME
NPCVEHICLETERM.Subtitle: BLD_NPCVEHICLE_SUBTITLE
NPCVEHICLETERM.Description_Text: A research station tailored to the needs of Technicians, and equipped with bespoke vehicular design software.

NPCBUILDERTERM.Name: BLD_NPCBUILDER_NAME
NPCBUILDERTERM.Subtitle: BLD_NPCBUILDER_SUBTITLE
NPCBUILDERTERM.Description_Text: A research station tailored to the needs of Construction Overseers, and equipped with architectural and engineering design software.

PLANTER.Name: BLD_PLANTER_NAME
PLANTER.Subtitle: BLD_PLANTER_SUBTITLE
PLANTER.Description_Text:
A self contained growth system for the indoor cultivation of agricultural crops.

Build requirement: Must be placed indoors.

PLANTERMEGA.Name: BLD_PLANTERMEGA_NAME
PLANTERMEGA.Subtitle: BLD_PLANTERMEGA_SUBTITLE
PLANTERMEGA.Description_Text:
A self contained growth system for the indoor cultivation of agricultural crops. Can support up to four plants.

Build requirement: Must be placed indoors.

TOXICPLANT.Name: UI_PLANT_5_NAME
TOXICPLANT.Subtitle: UI_PLANT_SUBTITLE
TOXICPLANT.Description_Text:
A spherical fungus with internal gills, found only in toxic biomes. Fungal Clusters can be transplanted for cultivation, yielding a bountiful harvest.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Toxic climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: <TECHNOLOGY>4 hours<>

SNOWPLANT.Name: UI_PLANT_7_NAME
SNOWPLANT.Subtitle: UI_PLANT_SUBTITLE
SNOWPLANT.Description_Text:
A large crystal flower with radiant blue blooms, found only in snowy biomes. Frostwort can be farmed and makes a reliable crop, and its adaptation to harsh conditions results in highly frequent harvests.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Frozen climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: <TECHNOLOGY>1 hour<>

RADIOPLANT.Name: UI_PLANT_6_NAME
RADIOPLANT.Subtitle: UI_PLANT_SUBTITLE
RADIOPLANT.Description_Text:
A luminous, leafy flowering plant that thrives in radioactive biomes and can be cultivated to yield a bountiful harvest.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Radioactive climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: <TECHNOLOGY>4 hours<>

BARRENPLANT.Name: UI_PLANT_9_NAME
BARRENPLANT.Subtitle: UI_PLANT_SUBTITLE
BARRENPLANT.Description_Text:
Native to barren biomes and capable of withstanding long periods of drought, Echinocactus is an edible succulent that responds well to cultivation, yielding a large but occasional harvest.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Barren climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: <TECHNOLOGY>16 hours<>

LUSHPLANT.Name: UI_PLANT_10_NAME
LUSHPLANT.Subtitle: UI_PLANT_SUBTITLE
LUSHPLANT.Description_Text:
A medium-sized, farmable plant that yields an occasional harvest of valuable Star Bulbs.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Lush climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: <TECHNOLOGY>4 hours<>

SCORCHEDPLANT.Name: UI_PLANT_8_NAME
SCORCHEDPLANT.Subtitle: UI_PLANT_SUBTITLE
SCORCHEDPLANT.Description_Text:
This 'living rock' is adapted to live in the extreme heat of scorched biomes. However, it can be farmed in most environments and, once established, yields a moderate harvest.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Hot climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: <TECHNOLOGY>16 hours<>

CREATUREPLANT.Name: UI_PLANT_1_NAME
CREATUREPLANT.Subtitle: UI_PLANT_SUBTITLE
CREATUREPLANT.Description_Text:
An inedible tuber that produces a small yield of Mordite crystals.

A peaceful alternative to the process of harvesting Mordite from the <TECHNOLOGY>corpses of creatures<>. Mordite Root must be grown in a <TECHNOLOGY>Hydroponics Tray<>.

Approximate growing time: <TECHNOLOGY>8 hours<>

POOPPLANT.Name: UI_PLANT_2_NAME
POOPPLANT.Subtitle: UI_PLANT_SUBTITLE
POOPPLANT.Description_Text:
A foul-smelling, farmable flower that replicates the chemical structure of faecal matter. When planted inside, yields a harvest of Faecium.

A good alternative to collecting Faecium by hand, which requires <TECHNOLOGY>feeding creatures<> and then <TECHNOLOGY>harvesting their droppings<>. Gutrot Flowers must be grown in a <TECHNOLOGY>Hydroponics Tray<>.

Approximate growing time: <TECHNOLOGY>4 hours<>

GRAVPLANT.Name: UI_PLANT_13_NAME
GRAVPLANT.Subtitle: UI_PLANT_SUBTITLE
GRAVPLANT.Description_Text:
A strange, potentially parasitic plant that yields an occasional harvest of the highly tradable commodity, Gravitino Balls.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Cannot be planted outdoors.

Approximate growing time: <TECHNOLOGY>2 hours<>

SACVENOMPLANT.Name: UI_PLANT_12_NAME
SACVENOMPLANT.Subtitle: UI_PLANT_SUBTITLE
SACVENOMPLANT.Description_Text:
A small, innocuous looking plant whose leaves periodically secrete a small amount of potent Sac Venom, a valuable trading commodity.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Cannot be planted outdoors.

Approximate growing time: <TECHNOLOGY>3 hours 20 mins<>

PEARLPLANT.Name: PLANT_PEARL_NAME
PEARLPLANT.Subtitle: PLANT_PEARL_SUBTITLE
PEARLPLANT.Description_Text:
A medium-sized, farmable Crystal Orb that yields an occasional harvest of valuable Albumen Pearls.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Cannot be planted outdoors.

Approximate growing time: <TECHNOLOGY>80 mins<>

NIPPLANT.Name: UI_PLANT_11_NAME
NIPPLANT.Subtitle: UI_PLANT_SUBTITLE
NIPPLANT.Description_Text:
This medicinal herb is known for its pungent buds, which are harvested to produce Gek Nip. NipNip thrives in dank environments, and often grows as a weed.

Suitable for hydroponic planting indoors. Needs a tropical or humid climate before planting outdoors.

CARBONPLANTER.Description_Text: A standing planter system for indoor cultivation of agricultural crops.

U_EXTRACTOR_S.Name: BLD_U_EXTRACTOR_NAME
U_EXTRACTOR_S.Subtitle: BLD_SILO_SUB
U_EXTRACTOR_S.Description_Text:
An automated mineral harvester. Determine a site with the <TECHNOLOGY>Surveying<> upgrade for the <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>. Mineral extraction rates and produced minerals will vary from site to site.

Requires <STELLAR>power<> to function. Connect to <TECHNOLOGY>Silos<> with <TECHNOLOGY>Pipelines<> to allow collection from more convenient sites.

U_GASEXTRACTOR.Name: BLD_U_GASEXTRACTOR_NAME
U_GASEXTRACTOR.Subtitle: BLD_SILO_SUB
U_GASEXTRACTOR.Description_Text:
An automated gas harvester. Determine a site with the <TECHNOLOGY>Surveying<> upgrade for the <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>. Gas extraction rates and produced gases will vary from site to site.

Requires <STELLAR>power<> to function. Connect to <TECHNOLOGY>Silos<> with <TECHNOLOGY>Pipelines<> to allow collection from more convenient sites.

U_SILO_S.Name: BLD_U_SILO_NAME
U_SILO_S.Subtitle: BLD_SILO_SUB
U_SILO_S.Description_Text:
Automated storage unit. Connect to a <TRADEABLE>Supply Grid<> using <TECHNOLOGY>Pipelines<>.

Automatically stores the output of various <STELLAR>Mineral<> and <STELLAR>Gas Extractors<>, allowing for increased capacity and more efficient siting. Can be located a long distances from the extraction site.

U_SOLAR_S.Name: BLD_U_SOLAR_S_NAME
U_SOLAR_S.Subtitle: BLD_UTILITY_SUB
U_SOLAR_S.Description_Text:
An efficient <STELLAR>power generator<>, this solar array will turn sunlight into the electrical energy required to power many base structures.

Generates <FUEL>no power at night<>. Partner with <TECHNOLOGY>Batteries<> to store energy for the hours of darkness.

U_GENERATOR_S.Name: BLD_U_GENERATOR_NAME
U_GENERATOR_S.Subtitle: BLD_UTILITY_SUB
U_GENERATOR_S.Description_Text:
When suitably placed in an area of high field strength, efficient electromagnetic dynamos are used to generate <STELLAR>near limitless power<>.

Locate appropriate sites with the <TECHNOLOGY>Surveying<> upgrade for the <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>. Power output will vary from site to site.

U_BIOGENERATOR.Name: BLD_U_BIOGENERATOR_NAME
U_BIOGENERATOR.Subtitle: BLD_UTILITY_SUB
U_BIOGENERATOR.Description_Text:
A small <STELLAR>power generator<>. Burns carbon-based fuel placed in its <TECHNOLOGY>furnace tank<> and converts it into usable power.

Connect power generators to base structures and technologies with <TECHNOLOGY>electrical wiring<>. Many parts require power to function.

U_POWERLINE.Name: BLD_U_POWERLINE_NAME
U_POWERLINE.Subtitle: BLD_UTILITY_SUB
U_POWERLINE.Description_Text:
High-capacity electrical wiring. Use wiring to connect <TECHNOLOGY>Power Generators<> to your base. Most technology, as well as structures with embedded lighting systems, require a power source to operate.

Wiring can be connected to <TECHNOLOGY>various switches<> to facilitate selective power flow.

U_PORTALLINE.Name: BLD_U_PORTALLINE_NAME
U_PORTALLINE.Subtitle: BLD_UTILITY_SUB
U_PORTALLINE.Description_Text: Advanced fibre-optic cabling, designed to link one or more <TECHNOLOGY>Short-Range Teleporters<>.

U_BYTEBEATLINE.Name: BLD_U_BBLINE_NAME
U_BYTEBEATLINE.Subtitle: UI_BYTEBEAT_UTIL_SUB
U_BYTEBEATLINE.Description_Text:
Advanced cabling, designed to link one or more <TECHNOLOGY>Bytebeat Generators<> or to connect a <TECHNOLOGY>Bytebeat Switch<> to the network.

The signal will synchronize connected lights and device to the generated waveform.

U_SWITCHWALL.Name: BLD_U_SWITCHWALLNAME
U_SWITCHWALL.Subtitle: BLD_UTILITY_SUB
U_SWITCHWALL.Description_Text:
A <STELLAR>power management device<>, the switch will toggle the flow of power when pulled.

Switches require both power and signal wires to control a device.

U_SWITCHPRESS.Name: BLD_U_SWITCHPRESS_NAME
U_SWITCHPRESS.Subtitle: BLD_UTILITY_SUB
U_SWITCHPRESS.Description_Text:
A <STELLAR>power management device<>, the switch will toggle the flow of power when stood upon or otherwise activated.

Switches require both power and signal wires to control a device.

U_BATTERY_S.Name: BLD_U_BATTERY_S_NAME
U_BATTERY_S.Subtitle: BLD_UTILITY_SUB
U_BATTERY_S.Description_Text:
Highly-efficient <TECHNOLOGY>energy storage units<>. Connect to a power grid, and onboard power management circuits will <STELLAR>automatically draw down spare capacity<> to charge its cells.

When the grid attempts to draw more power than is currently supplied, the battery will <STELLAR>automatically deploy power<> to make up the shortfall.

U_SWITCHBUTTON.Name: BLD_U_SWITCHBUTTON_NAME
U_SWITCHBUTTON.Subtitle: BLD_UTILITY_SUB
U_SWITCHBUTTON.Description_Text:
A <STELLAR>power management device<>, the switch will toggle the flow of power when used.

Switches require both power and signal wires to control a device.

U_SWITCHPROX.Name: BLD_U_SWITCHPROX_NAME
U_SWITCHPROX.Subtitle: BLD_UTILITY_SUB
U_SWITCHPROX.Description_Text:
A <STELLAR>power management device<>, the switch will toggle the flow of power when an entity is detected nearby.

Switches require both power and signal wires to control a device.

U_PIPELINE.Name: BLD_U_PIPELINE_NAME
U_PIPELINE.Subtitle: BLD_SILO_SUB
U_PIPELINE.Description_Text:
Flexible, high-strength piping. Able to withstand a highly-pressurised internal environment.

Used for connecting various <STELLAR>Mineral<> and <STELLAR>Gas Extractors<> to <TECHNOLOGY>Silos<>

U_TRANSISTOR1.Name: BLD_U_TRANSISTOR_NAME
U_TRANSISTOR1.Subtitle: BLD_UTILITY_SUB
U_TRANSISTOR1.Description_Text:
A <STELLAR>power management device<>, the switch will toggle the flow of power when used.

Switches require both power and signal wires to control a device.

U_TRANSISTOR2.Name: BLD_U_TRANSISTOR2_NAME
U_TRANSISTOR2.Subtitle: BLD_UTILITY_SUB
U_TRANSISTOR2.Description_Text:
A <STELLAR>power management device<>, this switch will toggle the flow of power when signaled by an incoming signal.

Switches require both power and signal wires to control a device.

U_MINIPORTAL.Name: BLD_MINIPORTAL_NAME
U_MINIPORTAL.Subtitle: BLD_MINIPORTAL_SUB
U_MINIPORTAL.Description_Text:
A low-powered teleporter, construction for instantaneous travel across short distances.

When <STELLAR>wired<> to both a power source and another short-range teleporter, allows near-instant travel between nearby locations.

U_MINIPORTAL_CV.Name: BLD_MINIPORTAL_NAME
U_MINIPORTAL_CV.Subtitle: BLD_MINIPORTAL_SUB
U_MINIPORTAL_CV.Description_Text:
A low-powered teleporter, construction for instantaneous travel across short distances.

When <STELLAR>wired<> to both a power source and another short-range teleporter, allows near-instant travel between nearby locations.

BYTEBEATSWITCH.Name: BLD_U_BBSWITCH_NAME
BYTEBEATSWITCH.Subtitle: UI_BYTEBEAT_UTIL_SUB
BYTEBEATSWITCH.Description_Text: A musical switching device, designed to interpret waveform signals generated by a <TECHNOLOGY>Bytebeat Generator<> and output electrical impulses to connected <TECHNOLOGY>lights<> and other devices.

POWERLINE_HIDER.Name: BLD_POWERLINE_HIDER_NAME
POWERLINE_HIDER.Subtitle: BLD_UTILITY_SUB
POWERLINE_HIDER.Description_Text:
Device to enable a wireless aesthetic in habitable bases.

Constructing the <TECHNOLOGY>Electrical Cloaking Unit<> within a powered base will reduce the visual prominence of all local <TECHNOLOGY>Electrical Wiring<>. Hidden wires will continue to supply electricity, provided they are sufficiently powered.
